title: PEARL: Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning for Selective Forgetting under Partial Preference Drift
abstract: arXiv:2611.05842v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: User preferences shift as needs, context, and tastes evolve. This matters for personalized recommendation, LLM response generation, and RLHF-trained reward models, which can become miscalibrated as preferences drift. Existing non-stationary bandit methods forget uniformly across all dimensions, but real preference shifts are typically partial: some dimensions go stale while others remain valid. Neural contextual bandits accumulate confidence monotonically via the Gram matrix, with no mechanism to direct uncertainty where predictions have gone wrong. We propose PEARL (Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning), which reverses the Gram update along feature directions where predictions are surprisingly wrong, while leaving confidence intact elsewhere. We prove that (i) any non-adaptive policy suffers linear regret after a preference shift, (ii) no fixed exploration rate achieves low regret in both stationary and non-stationary regime

translated_title: PEARL：面向部分偏好漂移下选择性遗忘的预测误差自适应正则化学习
translated_abstract: 用户偏好会随着需求、情境和品味的演变而发生漂移。这对个性化推荐、大语言模型响应生成以及通过RLHF训练的奖励模型至关重要，因为这些系统可能会随偏好漂移而变得失准。现有的非平稳赌博机方法在所有维度上均匀遗忘，但真实的偏好漂移通常是部分的：某些维度已经过时，而其他维度仍然有效。神经上下文赌博机通过Gram矩阵单调地累积置信度，缺乏将不确定性引导至预测出错方向的机制。我们提出了PEARL（预测误差自适应正则化学习），它在预测出现严重偏差的特征方向上反转Gram矩阵的更新，同时在其他方向上保持置信度不变。我们证明了：（i）任何非自适应策略在偏好漂移后都会遭受线性遗憾；（ii）没有固定的探索率能够在平稳和非平稳两种情况下都实现低遗憾。
tldr: PEARL提出了一种预测误差自适应的正则化学习方法，通过仅在预测出错的特征方向上反转Gram矩阵更新来实现选择性遗忘，从而有效应对部分偏好漂移，克服了传统方法均匀遗忘和固定探索率的局限。
en_tdlr: PEARL proposes a prediction error-adaptive regularized learning method that achieves selective forgetting by reversing Gram matrix updates only along feature directions where predictions err, effectively handling partial preference drift and overcoming the limitations of uniform forgetting and fixed exploration rates.
